subject: Synchronous review window: manager ops brief + forms & trigger matrix
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: emma@peopleops.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Synchronous review window: manager ops brief + forms & trigger matrix

Team —

TL;DR: proposal to run a short, synchronous review window for mid-June to early July to reduce exposure and speed up calibration. I attached the initial manager brief and a first draft of the rating trigger matrix for comments.

Why: last cycle's staggered schedule generated a lot of cross-communication and rework; a tighter window minimizes leakage and keeps raters aligned.

Proposal (high level):
- Manager window: July 6–9 (4 business days) — manager self-reviews and calibration meetings scheduled in that week.
- Calibration week: July 12–16 — comp/people leads for calibration reviews.
- Quiet mode comms: all external-facing comms disabled for impacted teams until July 17.

Attachments (for review):
- manager-brief-template.docx (instructions + timeline)
- rating-trigger-matrix.xlsx (rules for escalation/bonus exceptions)
- confidential-handling-guidelines.pdf (redaction and limited-distribution rules)

Asks: please review and reply with: 1) sign-off on dates or alternate preferred window; 2) any missing escalation paths; 3) approved owners for audit evidence (Emma, looped).

If we can lock scope by EOD Wednesday (6/23) I will publish the manager packet and schedule the 30-min calibration prep sync.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Synchronous review window: manager ops brief + forms & trigger matrix

+1 to the compressed window. A couple of quick notes: 

- Please add a short escalation path for managers who need interim approvals (simple four-step approval: manager -> director -> comp -> people-lead). Put that into the matrix as a column so we can filter.
- We need a "quiet mode" email template for managers to use with direct reports when asked; otherwise comms will leak.
- Confirm SLAs for audit evidence — who on the people team is the primary for evidence requests? cc Emma to confirm.

If we can get those three items in the next pass, I'm ok with the proposed dates.

Vivek
VP, Engineering (cc: ops interface)

Thanks — I reviewed the drafts and added inline suggestions. Key changes I propose (summary):

1) Regional staging: split the window by timezone cohorts to reduce late-night meetings; US cohort July 6–9, APAC staggered the following week if needed. Adds a day but reduces manager burnout.

2) Escalation -> make approval step explicit: detail who signs off for >10% comp changes. See attached escalation-approval-flow.drawio.

3) Quiet-mode templates: added a set for ICs and managers (quiet-mode-email-templates.txt). These are designed to minimize detail while acknowledging the window.

4) Evidence owner: recommend People Ops (Emma primary) and Legal (Raj shah at Acme for vendor/legal requests) be listed explicitly in the manager brief.

Inline comments follow the original doc. I attached both the templates and the flow diagram.

Small edits: change "publish by EOD Wed" to "publish by EOD Thur (6/24)" to allow a final pass.

- Laura
Director, People Experience

- Manager window (US cohort): July 6–9.
- Calibration: July 12–16.
- Publication of manager packet: Friday, June 25 (EOD).
- Evidence owners: Emma Collins (PeopleOps consultant) primary; Raj Shah (Legal contact) for external/legal requests.
- Escalation: manager -> director -> comp -> people-lead (documented in the attached flow).
- Quiet-mode: templates consolidated on Drive.

Action items: 
- Laura: finalize quiet-mode templates and update the manager brief by 6/24 (assigned).
- Aditya: update the rating-trigger-matrix with the explicit approval column and share filterable view by 6/24.
- Emma: confirm evidence retention wording (2-year recommendation) and supply final SOC2 mapping.
- Vivek: confirm uplift exceptions threshold (what counts as >10% comp change) by 6/24.

I'm scheduling a 30-min sync on Monday 6/29 to walk through the packet and sign-offs — invite to follow. The consolidated packet and the attachments have been uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-review-window-ops (Doc: manager-brief-FINAL.docx).
